podcast.title: Target of Taylor Swift's "Dear John" (2010)
podcast.body: John Mayer, referred to as "Paramore John Mayer," was the target of Taylor Swift's "most devastating diss," "Dear John," from her 2010 album "Speak Now." The song explicitly addressed their age difference and his behavior, with lyrics like, "Don't you think I was too young to be missed with the girl in the dress cried the whole?" "her takedown of Paramore John Mayer, who was much older than Swift but not Wiser."
